name: Gut, urinary and reproductive tract visceral function
rationale: Members span gastrointestinal motility and secretion, micturition, uterine contraction/parturition and male reproductive acts (erection, insemination), unlike confusables built on serotonin/tachykinin receptors, enteric neural development or generic smooth muscle relaxation.

qualifier: sperm motility, acrosome reaction and zona binding
name: Sperm motility, acrosome reaction and egg fertilization
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, motility, acrosome exocytosis, zona pellucida binding/penetration, gamete fusion and egg activation, while confusables cover spermatid structure, germline epigenetics or meiosis.

name: Epidermal cornified envelope and lipoxygenase-derived barrier lipids
rationale: Members combine cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier formation with the 12R-LOX/hepoxilin and linoleate lipid pathways whose defects cause ichthyosis (ARCI), distinguishing it from keratinocyte differentiation and generic fatty acid confusables.

name: Gonad development and gonadotropin-regulated ovarian follicle cycle
rationale: Members cover testis/ovary development and sex determination together with gonadotropin, activin, AMH, progesterone and prolactin control of folliculogenesis, ovulation and luteal function, which confusables (gamete/meiosis, genital tract morphogenesis) lack.

qualifier: Rap1 and MAPK linkage in platelets
name: Rap1 and integrin signalling to MAPK in platelet activation
rationale: Members are Rap1 signalling, integrin linkage to MAPK via GRB2:SOS and p130Cas, adhesion-cytoskeleton modules and platelet activation sets, distinct from coagulation, GPCR-Rho or focal adhesion/ROCK confusables.

qualifier: DNA CpG methylation and histone lysine methyltransferase complexes
name: DNA methylation and histone lysine methyltransferase complexes
rationale: Members combine CpG DNA methylation, imprinting and facultative heterochromatin with PRC2, PKMT and WDR5/MLL4 lysine methyltransferase complexes, whereas confusables emphasize arginine methylation, demethylases or chromatin remodelers.

qualifier: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptor control
name: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and clock control of white adipogenesis
rationale: Members cover white fat differentiation and PPAR/PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs plus ROR/REV-ERB and BMAL/CLOCK regulation, absent from confusables focused on brown/beige fat or LXR-driven lipid homeostasis.

core: Sodium and potassium transmembrane transport regulation
name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium and potassium transport
rationale: All members regulate Na+ import/export and K+ uptake, including renal sodium transport and aldosterone response, while confusables centre on chloride cotransporters or osmotic stress.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly and succinate-linked respiration
name: TCA cycle intermediates and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), TCA enzyme maturation, Fe-S cluster assembly and succinate-to-ubiquinone/ATP synthesis, which the PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and lipoylation confusables lack.

name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered release and short-term potentiation
rationale: Members link presynaptic depolarization and cytosolic calcium to vesicle exocytosis, short-term potentiation and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials, whereas confusables address vesicle priming/active zone, inhibitory synapse assembly or G-protein inhibition of channels.

qualifier: extracellular antagonism of Nodal and BMP signalling
name: Somitogenesis and extracellular sequestration of Nodal/BMP signalling
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation and axis elongation plus left-right Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand/BMP sequestration, which distinguishes it from limb, Notch glycosylation, Hox and neural plate confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment and retinal cell development
name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members are IFT, BBSome and ciliary cargo targeting, basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly together with rod/cone outer segment development, while confusables cover motile cilia/sperm axonemes, centrosome-spindle or tubulin modification.

name: RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte maturation and bone ossification
rationale: Members span chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, endochondral and intramembranous ossification and RUNX2 control of osteoblasts, distinguishing it from joint cartilage, tendon or osteoblast-only confusables.

name: p53-p21 G1 arrest and CDKN2A defects evading senescence
rationale: Members are TP53 regulation and p21-driven G1 arrest plus p16INK4A/p14ARF loss-of-function evasion of oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, which senescence-program and RB/CDK confusables lack.

name: Histone and tubulin lysine acetylation
rationale: Members concern peptidyl-lysine and internal protein acetylation by HATs and tubulin acetylation balance (with acetylation-linked centriole control), unlike tubulin glutamylation, CENP-A chromatin, BAF or methylation confusables.

qualifier: COPII vesicle cargo loading at ER exit sites
name: COPII vesicle cargo loading and ER export
rationale: All members describe COPII coat assembly, cargo concentration at ER exit sites and anterograde ER-to-Golgi transport, as opposed to COPI retrograde traffic, ER targeting or ERAD confusables.

name: Inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Every member is a disease variant of a urea cycle enzyme (NAGS, CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL, ARG1), while confusables hold the normal urea cycle, arginine/ornithine metabolism and transporter defects.

name: Golgi ribbon dynamics, membrane tubulation and vesicle budding
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly and positioning, COPI vesicle budding, membrane tubulation and constitutive secretion, unlike confusables focused on intra-Golgi/retrograde COPI traffic or Rab/ARF regulation.

name: Locomotor coordination and cerebellar Purkinje layer formation
rationale: Members are adult locomotion, walking and the righting reflex together with Purkinje cell layer formation, distinguishing it from exploratory/grooming behavior and hindbrain or granule-layer development confusables.

core: Anterior eye and ductal gland development
name: Lens transparency, cornea and lacrimal/bile duct development
rationale: Members concern lens fiber morphogenesis and transparency (gap-junction transport), cornea and lacrimal gland development plus bile duct development, whereas confusables are inner ear, retina or ocular vasculature themes.

qualifier: deamination editing, oxidative demethylation and alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase deamination editing, demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members are ADAR/APOBEC base deamination (including antiviral restriction), TET/TDG 5mC demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, which distinguishes it from retroviral life-cycle, excision repair and broad DNA repair confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative BCR tuning with B cell proliferation
name: BCR signalling regulation and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members are antigen-triggered BCR second messengers, CD22 and positive/negative BCR regulation, B cell proliferation and B-cell-enriched modules, unlike confusables centred on B cell subsets, germinal centres or RAS/BTK signalling.

qualifier: fucosylation, sialylation and blood group/selectin-ligand glycans
name: Fucosylated and sialylated glycoprotein and glycosphingolipid glycan synthesis
rationale: Members span N- and O-glycan processing, glycosphingolipid and blood group antigen synthesis, GDP-fucose and sialic acid supply and sulfated selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling, whereas confusables cover GAG/O-mannose glycosylation or nucleotide-sugar metabolism.

name: Glutathione synthesis and gamma-glutamyl cycle defects
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis/recycling and inherited defects of GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH and ACY1, while confusables concern glutathione transport/catabolism or sulfur amino acid metabolism.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte recruitment and chemotaxis restraint
rationale: Members are CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules, migration, monocyte aggregation and negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, distinct from confusables emphasizing positive chemotaxis, inflammation or chemokine clusters.
